hook.en: Gentle movements that slide or lightly tension a nerve so it moves freely and tolerates movement better.
hook.ur: Neurodynamic mobilization mein nervous system aur us ke aas-paas ke tissues ki movement tolerance par kaam kiya jata hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Neurodynamic Mobilization is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Neurodynamic Mobilization kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Neurodynamic mobilization treats the nervous system's ability to glide and stretch during movement. You use specific limb and neck positions to either slide the nerve (sliders) or lightly tension it (tensioners), always staying below sharp pain.
text.ur: Neurodynamic assessment ki bunyaad par nervous system aur us ke surrounding interfaces ki graded movement karwai jati hai. Is mein slider ya tensioner strategy choose ki ja sakti hai.

simpler.en: Gentle movements that slide or lightly tension a nerve so it moves freely and tolerates movement better.
simpler.ur: Neurodynamic mobilization mein nervous system aur us ke aas-paas ke tissues ki movement tolerance par kaam kiya jata hai.

text.en: A nerve is like a wire inside a flexible tube. When you bend the arm, the wire should slide along the tube. If it sticks or is irritated, moving the joints can pull on it and cause symptoms.
text.ur: Nerve ek lachakdaar pipe ke andar taar jaisi hai. Jab aap arm moorte hain to taar pipe ke andar slide honi chahiye. Agar woh atak jaye ya irritate ho, to joints ki movement us par khinchao daal kar symptoms paida kar sakti hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Nerves must glide and tolerate tension; sensitive nerves may reproduce symptoms with limb and neck movements.
**2.** Sliders (one end shortens while the other lengthens) are gentler than tensioners (both ends lengthen).
**3.** Use sensitizing movements, such as tilting the head, to test whether symptoms are neural, but never force through sharp pain.
text.ur: Maqsad neural movement tolerance behtar karna, mechanosensitivity kam karna aur function restore karna hai. Slider aam tor par tensioner ke muqablay mein kam strain paida karta hai aur shuru mein zyada tolerate ho sakta hai. Neurodynamic test ko akelay interpret nahi karna chahiye; neurological examination bhi zaroori hai.

question.en: Vocabulary first — clinicians use this word a lot. What does **Neural tension test** mean?
question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Neural tension test** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en: A movement that slides the nerve without increasing overall tension.
text.ur: A movement that slides the nerve without increasing overall tension.

feedback.en: Close, but that's the meaning of **Slider**. Read the word **Neural tension test** once more and try again.
feedback.ur: Qareeb hain, lekin yeh **Slider** ka matlab hai. **Neural tension test** ko dobara parhein aur phir koshish karein.

text.en: A sequence of limb positions that stresses a nerve, for example the upper limb tension test for the median nerve.

text.en:
So when does **Neurodynamic Mobilization** make sense?
• Arm or leg symptoms (tingling, aching, pulling) reproduced by neural tension positions with a clear pattern.
• Nerve irritation after injury or entrapment where movement is guarded.
text.ur: Selected radicular ya peripheral nerve mechanosensitivity; immobilization ke baad neural movement restriction.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Worsening weakness, spinal cord signs or cauda equina symptoms.
• Severe, unstable or rapidly worsening nerve symptoms.
• Pushing into sharp pain, lingering numbness or tingling.
text.ur:
Acute radiculopathy, diabetes ya neuropathy, aur recent nerve repair.
Barhta hua neurological deficit, cauda equina symptoms, aisi acute nerve injury jise protection chahiye, ya unexplained severe neurological signs.
Symptoms ko force karna, end range par aggressively hold karna aur worsening numbness ya weakness ignore karna unsafe hai. Low-irritability approach se start karne ka faisla clinical assessment par depend karta hai; new neurological deficit ho to prompt evaluation karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Take the history
steps.detail: Ask where the symptoms are, what provokes them, and whether they are constant or movement-related.

steps.title: Perform the neural test
steps.detail: Example: for the median nerve, lower the shoulder, abduct the arm to about 90 degrees, extend the wrist and fingers, rotate the arm outward, then straighten the elbow. Stop at the first clear symptom.

steps.title: Use structural differentiation
steps.detail: Add or remove head tilt; if symptoms change, the nerve is likely involved.

steps.title: Treat with sliders first
steps.detail: Alternate elbow straightening with neck tilting toward it, gently, short of strong symptoms.

steps.title: Retest and teach
steps.detail: Reassess the test and give a gentle home slider if helpful.

beats.ur:
1. Neurological screening karein aur comparable neurodynamic test establish karein.
2. Irritability ke mutabiq slider ya tensioner choose karein.
3. Ek ya zyada joints ko rhythmic tareeqay se non-threatening range mein move karein.
4. Neurological symptoms ko musalsal reproduce karne se bachein.
5. Test aur patient ki functional complaint dobara assess karein.

question.en: Imagine the patient is in front of you. What do you do FIRST?
question.ur: Farz karein patient aap ke saamne hai. Aap SAB SE PEHLE kya karenge?

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: sliders 8-10 slow repetitions, 2-3 sets, a few times per day. Symptoms should be mild and settle quickly.
text.ur: Aksar 10–20 gentle repetitions ke 1–3 sets istemal kiye jate hain. Zyada irritability mein chhoti range aur sliders ko tarjeeh di ja sakti hai.

beats.patient: Lena, 41, tingling in her thumb and index finger when typing, worse with her elbow straight.
beats.assessment: Median nerve test reproduces tingling at about 120 degrees of elbow extension, and tilting the head away increases it.
beats.treatment: She does gentle median nerve sliders: elbow straightens as the head tilts toward the arm, then reverses. 10 repetitions, 3 sets.
beats.reassess: Elbow extension increases by 20 degrees before symptoms start. She continues the sliders and adjusts her workstation.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein leg raise test ke dauran patient ko leg mein familiar pulling sensation hoti hai. Assessment ke baad clinician low-irritability slider ka response check kar sakta hai aur symptoms ko monitor karta hai. Yeh fictional example hai, patient-specific prescription nahi.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Using aggressive tensioners on an irritable nerve.
• Skipping a neurological screen.
• Treating symptoms that are not neural.
text.ur:
Sab se aam ghaltiyan:
• Using aggressive tensioners on an irritable nerve.
• Skipping a neurological screen.
• Treating symptoms that are not neural.

text.en: Reviews suggest neural mobilization may help pain and function in some nerve-related conditions, though trial quality varies. The mechanisms are still debated.
text.ur: Symptoms, range aur functional task ko treatment se pehle aur baad compare karein. Neurodynamic techniques selected conditions mein useful ho sakti hain, magar nerve ko mechanically 'release' karne ka claim evidence se zyada strong na banayein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Slide first, tension later, and never provoke sharp or lingering symptoms.**
text.ur: Neural mobilization se distal symptoms ko baar baar provoke nahi karna chahiye.
